description: Get a Robinhood stock token's current on-chain state: total supply, treasury balance, multiplier, ledger coverage, open integrity flags and the look-alikes pegproof knows of. history is the hourly check of its supply against its full mint and burn history: status (match, mismatch or ledger-behind), diff, the block compared and when; null before the first check. events_24h and events_7d count the mints, burns, issues and redeems in the last 24 and 168 buckets of 36,000 blocks; Robinhood Chain makes about 9 blocks a second. Amounts are raw units with 18 decimals. Pass a ticker (NVDA) or a contract address on Robinhood Chain (4663); for a known look-alike address, the answer names the token it imitates. On-chain observations reconstructed from chain event logs, not financial advice. To only tell a listed contract from a look-alike, check_address answers that alone.

token.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a contract address (0x followed by 40 hex digits).

name: get_token_summary
title: Get a token's current state
